scientific_question: Did the shared learned full-rank pre-GELU frame fail because routed expert objectives cancel in the one shared frame, and is the missing node-specific direction representable by the largest paper-like grouped channel modulation that still preserves at least 200x paired-matrix compression?

causal_parent.finding: The learned shared square frame improved heldout endpoint recovery over its fixed-frame control by 0.214207/0.212786, but improved input-JVP recovery by only 0.022823/0.022581 and reached absolute JVP recovery only 0.012193/0.011855. The frame moved substantially, so the residual is representational rather than a disconnected optimizer.

theory.gelu_normal_field: For f_n(x)=Wproj_n GELU(Wfc_n x+b_n), the local derivative is Wproj_n diag(GELU'(Wfc_n x+b_n)) Wfc_n. The parent result shows that a global input frame can improve values without matching this node- and activation-dependent normal field.
theory.sharing_hypothesis: If the 96 routed expert nodes require different normal rotations, gradients of their exact output-plus-JVP objective with respect to the one shared effective frame should cancel within a layer. This is measured at the fitted parent endpoints, not inferred from a different butterfly family.
theory.paper_modulation_connection: The Mapping Networks paper modulates a fixed mapping by latent coordinates. The smallest analogous repair here is node-specific grouped multiplicative modulation of either the 768 compact frame outputs or the 768 frame inputs, rather than another learned dense basis or additive residual.
theory.left_group_formula: With effective learned frame W in R^(768x768), node n uses c_n = a_n^L elementwise (W x), where one scalar is shared by each contiguous group of 12 compact coordinates.
theory.right_group_formula: Alternatively node n uses c_n = W (a_n^R elementwise x), where one scalar is shared by each contiguous group of 12 input coordinates.
theory.tangent_projection: For each node objective, differentiate with respect to an unconstrained clone of the fitted effective frame W. Project that full Frobenius gradient onto the 64 mutually orthogonal, unit-Frobenius left-group or right-group scaling directions induced by W. Explained squared gradient energy and crossed coefficient cosine quantify whether a budget-compatible modulation contains a stable descent direction.
theory.scope: This is a zero-checkpoint-update same-gauge diagnostic. It does not fit modulation, select language-model loss, or authorize training.

replay_protocol.objective: Per-node normalized rank-448 coefficient output MSE plus 1.0 times normalized analytic coefficient-JVP MSE, exactly matching the parent fit objective while holding hidden bias, output modulation, write basis, procedural S/T maps, routing, and dense targets fixed.
replay_protocol.frame_coordinate: Differentiate with respect to the fitted effective row-normalized frame W, not raw_frame. This avoids the radial null direction introduced by row normalization and makes the modulation tangent exact.

metrics.within_layer_conflict: For each diagonal endpoint/data cell and layer, report pairwise cosine across eight raw full-frame node gradients, negative-pair fraction, finite nonzero count, and cancellation ratio ||sum_e g_e||^2/(E sum_e ||g_e||^2).
metrics.same_endpoint_data_stability: For each endpoint, compare corresponding node full-frame gradients between discovery A and B at that fixed endpoint.
metrics.same_data_endpoint_drift: For each data bank, compare corresponding node gradients between independently fitted endpoints; this is descriptive and cannot by itself authorize a static modulation.
metrics.group_tangent_energy: For left and right 64-group tangent families, report per-node squared Frobenius-gradient energy captured by the orthonormal tangent, its mean and minimum-layer mean for every cell, and corresponding coefficient cosine across data banks at each fixed endpoint.
metrics.selection_rule: A side is supported only if it passes every frozen energy and fixed-endpoint stability gate. If both pass, choose the side with the larger minimum across diagonal-cell mean explained energies; exact ties choose left. No rank, grouping, threshold, or endpoint may be chosen after values are seen.

decision_rule.group_modulation_supported: Shared-gradient conflict passes in every diagonal layer and at least one 64-group side passes every energy and fixed-endpoint coefficient-stability gate. Authorize only a separately preregistered zero-update functional fit oracle for the selected one-sided node modulation at 124M; do not train.
decision_rule.conflict_but_group_modulation_insufficie: Shared-gradient conflict passes but neither budget-compatible group tangent passes. Close static grouped modulation and authorize only a deliberately nondeployable node-private full-frame ceiling to determine whether sharing or the fixed S/T topology is the remaining bound.
decision_rule.shared_frame_not_cancelled: Any diagonal layer fails the conflict gates. Do not add node conditioning; close the sharing diagnosis and return to the fixed S/T plus GELU topology.
decision_rule.activation_conditioned: A group side has enough diagonal-cell energy but fails either fixed-endpoint crossed-bank coefficient-stability gate. Static node modulation is closed; only a separately preregistered activation-conditioned zero-update theory audit is allowed.

systems.performance_rule: Run focused tests and an exact-shape timing preflight. Foreground-poll only when projected complete runtime is at most five minutes; otherwise launch a persistent @Codex terminal/error watchdog before execution.
